purpose: Normal-speed browser rendering and OS-reported presentation on a confirmed 180-Hz desktop.

environment.selected_display: Primary desktop output; game window wholly inside it
environment.audio: Zero output gain plus muted test-browser output. AudioContext and ring-buffer consumption remained active.
environment.background_work: Other applications were left running; this was not an isolated GPU benchmark.

method.boot: Normal boot and original single-human Versus menu path; no RAM fixture or save-state injection.
method.inputs: Ordinary keyboard events: direction changes every 3 guest seconds, boost pulses every 2 seconds, fire pulses every 0.8 seconds; polled every 25 ms.
method.measurement: After warm-up, approximately 65 seconds of active fullscreen combat. The 120 run was measured after recording stopped and a 3-second settling period.
method.comparison: Sequential controls used the same build, input policy and display settings. Match setup was automatic, not a deterministic same-match A/B.
method.clock_alignment: QPC aligned to browser timeOrigin plus performance.now through a precise UTC anchor. Select GPU-process presents whose QPC timestamp lies inside the browser counter window.
method.presentmon_start: Interactive desktop session, before launching the test browser.
method.browser_instrumentation: Bounded in-memory rAF and completed-frame callbacks; no per-frame console output or GPU-submit wrapper in these final runs.
method.browser_profile: Isolated headed test profile with automation defaults, browser sandbox enabled, foreground native fullscreen; no frame-rate-limit/vsync override.
method.runtime_errors: No uncaught page-error log in either accepted run. Console retained an unattributed resource 404, ignored powerPreference notices and a zero-workgroup warning; none stopped the test.

scope_limits: OS display events do not measure panel pixel response or establish that every image contains distinct interpolated motion.
The selected runs establish mean delivery, not uniform frame pacing; interval distributions are retained.
This is active single-human Versus combat, not whole-game, split-screen, phone, 144-Hz gameplay or multiplayer acceptance.
No fresh audio equivalence or exact underrun-count measurement.
Earlier trace attempts reported missing display fields or overflow and were excluded from the final display-rate comparison.
Full private browser profiles, absolute paths, process IDs, swapchain addresses and unrelated processes are excluded.

runs.canvas_note: Fullscreen output canvas, not the original GS rendering resolution.
Fullscreen output canvas, not the original GS rendering resolution.

source_archive: Private pc-high-refresh test archive. Relative names and hashes identify retained files; they are not download links.
